messages:
Jamie: Quick heads-up — changing the release-train canary policy and a short freeze next week. Please read and action.
Jamie: TL;DR: (1) Canary windows are now staggered by priority lane (high/medium/low) — mandatory for all deploys touching model-serving or routing; (2) Soft freeze from Tue 09:00 UTC to Wed 09:00 UTC for the train; (3) Exceptions must go through the release board (ping @Sanjay). :warning:
Jamie: New canary schedule (applies to EU & US regions):
```
High: Mon-Fri 02:00-04:00 UTC
Medium: Mon-Fri 05:00-07:00 UTC
Low: Mon-Fri 08:00-10:00 UTC
```
Jamie: Reason: we've seen cascading evictions when concurrent canaries overlap during peak cache warmup. Staggering reduces KV pressure and gives SRE time to intervene. More in the doc: https://redwood.internal/release/canary-policy
Ops-bot: AUTO: Canary schedule updated in calendar for next 2 weeks. Jobs created: 7. See /deployments/calendar
Rachel: Quick Q — does this soft freeze block hotpatches for regressions? If yes we should define emergency path.
Sanjay: Rachel — hotpatches allowed if they follow emergency roll procedure: 1) triage in #eng-oncall, 2) 2-person approval from oncall + release lead, 3) deploy must be marked `emergency=true` so it bypasses the freeze. I'll add a checklist to the doc.
Maya: Also adding: teams should tag any model-quant changes as `kv-impact` so ops can pre-schedule a warmup. Small ask but helped last month.
deploy-bot: BUILD: canary-job/priority-high-2026-03-30 queued (id: cj-7892). Status: queued.
Jamie: Action items:
- Release leads: confirm your priority lane by EOD today.
- SRE: monitor KV eviction metric and set temporary scale triggers (Sanjay has the runbook).
- Devs touching serving/routing: add `kv-impact` tag and schedule warmup run.
If you need an exception, @Sanjay and I will review. Thanks — please react with :thumbsup: when you read.
Sanjay: I'll host a quick 10m sync at 16:00 UTC for release leads to go over the checklist. Invite sent.
Rachel: ack — will update our release docs and set the emergency process in our playbook.
Maya: :thumbsup: adding kv-impact tags to the PR template now.
Jamie: small note to PMs: this is to avoid user-facing latency regressions during warmup windows. We expect normal rollout cadence to resume after Wed 09:00 UTC unless we encounter a regression.
Ops-bot: INCIDENT-ALERT: KV eviction metric spiked last night 03:12 UTC, spike resolved by autoscale. Logged under INC-2026-0319-02. Teams impacted: serving-eu. See incident thread.
